description: A third-party KaTeX-based math plugin may be registered on the Markdown engine before the slide-extension hook is applied. The slide engine applies its fitting-math treatment, observable through a distinguishing marker attribute, only when slide mode is active. These boundary scenarios isolate inline-only math, block-only math, math rendered outside slide mode, and slide-mode math when no math plugin was registered. The input supplies the Markdown source containing math and optionally registers the math plugin; output reports the math and fitting-math markers.
